clips.yt_title: How Deep The Mariana Trench Really Goes #Shorts
clips.ig_caption:
The Mariana Trench doesn’t just go deep—it rewrites what deep means. 🌊⬇️

At 10.994 km, you could sink Mount Everest and still have over a mile of water above its peak. No sunlight. No rescue. Just 1,000+ atmospheres of pressure waiting to crush anything that isn’t built for the abyss.

We sent a submersible down to see what’s really hiding in the dark. What it found will change how you see our planet.

#Abyss #Depth #Explore
